//: THE port scheme of Coday, the single source of truth. Read by port-scheme.ts, scripts/web-local.ts, apps/client/proxy.conf.mjs, apps/client-e2e/playwright.config.ts and scripts/web-dev-tmux.sh. Files that cannot read it (Nx project.json, .idea run configurations) repeat the DEV values and are guarded by port-scheme-consistency.spec.ts. blockSize: width of the block a stack owns [base, base + blockSize - 1]. offsets: the role ports inside a block. profiles: first block (base) of each profile and the distance (step) between its candidate blocks, within the same thousand: prod 3000, 3020, 3040... and local 3010, 3030, 3050... interleave and never collide, dev 4000, 4010, 4020...
